headline: UK Businesses Face £1.1 Billion Rates Hike Following Inflation Spike
summary: Companies across England face a £1.1 billion increase in business rates starting next April driven by the recent surge in the national inflation rate.
why: Rising operating expenses and mandatory tax hikes can squeeze corporate profit margins, particularly for retail and small businesses.
